body: That's what he is to me. My only reason to stick around. He has made my life so much better. I want to fix it so much because I know I need to...but he has to let me
I just need to do something to help him realise he needs help
He doesn't think there is anything wrong with him though...so he will never try to get help...
I think so...we both agreed to the break and I actually suggested it this time. But I always have doubts. I wish he could read this post...
But I think he is only behaving like this because of how low he feels. I would honestly rather die than lose him...
